TAME Space Compass

Terms of Use

TAME Space Compass is a space-reference tool for orientation and spatial review. It should not be treated as medical, financial, legal, or guaranteed life advice.

Product Positioning

The app is intended for compass reference, nine-grid layout review, floor plan organization, and eight-sector direction suggestions.

It does not provide destiny guarantees, wealth guarantees, or professional medical, legal, or investment advice.

Usage Restrictions

  • Do not use the app for illegal activity or deceptive promotion.
  • Do not treat it as a substitute for professional diagnosis or high-risk decision making.

Disclaimer

All content is provided for folk-culture reference only, is not scientific evidence, and does not constitute any real-world guarantee.
